name: component-naming-convention
description: Enforce consistent component naming conventions, preferring descriptive names like 'IssueList' over generic names like 'Issues'
message:
Consider using more descriptive component names. For example:
- 'Issues' → 'IssueList'
- 'Users' → 'UserList'
- 'Projects' → 'ProjectList'
- 'Tasks' → 'TaskList'
- 'Items' → 'ItemList'
- 'List' → 'ListComponent'
- 'Details' → 'DetailsView'
- 'View' → 'ViewComponent'

rules.name: shared-component-naming-convention
rules.description: Shared components should not end with 'Page' suffix
rules.message:
Shared components should not end with 'Page'. Rename the component to remove the 'Page' suffix.

Examples:
- Change 'IssueListPage.razor' to 'IssueList.razor'
- Change 'IssueDetailsPage.razor' to 'IssueDetails.razor'
- Change 'SubIssueListItemPage.razor' to 'SubIssueListItem.razor'

Note: Only page components in the Pages directory should end with 'Page'.
